structure.unit: Interpleader; Claims of Third Parties to Property Distrained or Levied On, Etc
Claims of Third Parties to Property Distrained or Levied on

law.catch_line: Return of such bond to clerk's office
law.text: Any indemnifying bond taken by an officer under the preceding section shall be returned by him within twenty-one days to the clerk's office of the circuit court of the county or city wherein the property levied on, or to be levied on, is located.
